method: Serial public API, cached. SHA256(qcc-tiers-v1:username) ordered members of three clubs, first 2500. Current rapid 150-1050 and 30+ rapid games. Last three game archives; up to four eligible games per contributing account per tier, stop at 40 games. Rated standard rapid, BOTH game ratings in [target-100,target+100), games at least 20 plies. Four positions at floor(length * .15/.35/.6/.8), no move-quality filtering. Contributor accounts split before evaluation by hash order, alternating tuning/validation. Convenience sample, not a platform rating.
